name: Analyze and interpret specific philosophical texts and arguments
description: Users asked to analyze, interpret, critique, or summarize specific philosophical texts, arguments, and concepts, often requiring the application of various philosophical frameworks to diverse materials such as literature, art, or social phenomena. The requests frequently involved comparing different thinkers' views or extracting thematic connections and citations from provided source materials.
